dependencies.name: jQuery
dependencies.alternative: Native DOM APIs plus targeted helpers
dependencies.migrationPlan: Remove jQuery usage from page bootstrapping and event binding in favor of native DOM and delegated listeners.

dependencies.name: jquery.cookie
dependencies.migrationPlan: Migrate cookie read/write calls to a maintained package or localStorage fallback module.

dependencies.name: Vue
dependencies.alternative: Vue 3 + composition API or petite-vue for incremental migration
dependencies.migrationPlan: Create compatibility layer for legacy option API blocks, then incrementally migrate templates and state adapters to Vue 3.

dependencies.name: pako
dependencies.alternative: Native CompressionStream when browser support is sufficient
dependencies.migrationPlan: Track browser CompressionStream support and reassess replacement in annual review.

dependencies.name: jquery.tips
dependencies.migrationPlan: Limit plugin usage surface and replace validation hints with maintained UI feedback components.

dependencies.name: cocoMessage
dependencies.migrationPlan: Document current API usage and wrap with a project-owned adapter to allow future replacement without business changes.

quarterlyPlan.goal: Stabilize and inventory all vendored dependencies
deliverables: Freeze vendored inventory with owner and risk tags
Replace jquery.cookie usage with maintained storage abstraction
Replace jQuery bootstrapping/event hooks with native DOM implementation
Retire jquery.tips and move to maintained feedback component
Run security regression checks on all replacement paths

quarterlyPlan.goal: Modernize framework layer and isolate remaining legacy bundles
deliverables: Start Vue 3 migration pilot for key interactive modules
Re-audit third-party dependency posture and publish next-year plan
